next.reason: 1985 VII.3.2.3 SR1: 'The level indicator FD identifies the beginning of a file description entry and must precede file-name-1.' §2023:13.4.5.2 Format 1 (sequential) begins '<u>FD</u> file-name-1', so FD still opens the entry and precedes file-name-1. Same requirement, stated by the general format.
